resources.string: The one color every palette grows from. Change it and the whole theme follows.
How the palettes are drawn from the seed, from calm and muted to loud and playful.
Which version of the Material color rules builds the scheme. The 2025 spec is the one Expressive themes use.
How far apart text and its background sit. A higher level makes every pair easier to read.
The color each palette is built from. They come from the seed until you set one yourself.
A pin holds one role at a color of your own, whatever the seed does.
Color families beyond primary, secondary and tertiary, each with its own tones and roles.
What the export is written for. Some options only exist for some targets, so they show up when they apply.
